messages.subject: Re: site visit Thursday
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom — confirming the warehouse demo is at 10am Thursday, ask for me at reception and bring photo ID for the floor. Hard hats provided.

Marcus

[Sent from my phone]

— Tom, apologies, I think this was meant for a different Tom at the engineering firm; please ignore. M.
